Unit u02 applies the functional equation to derive the root pairing rho -> -1/(N rho) and states confinement to |rho|=1/sqrt(N). quality_reason: Accepted because the three distinct units explicitly support every link in the mechanism and preserve the proof burden between symmetry and full circle confinement.
